defects.evidence: TestProbeCounterDOMState (testdata/probe_dom_test.go, real browser): counter host div exists (id=counter-ef_sales, 96px/700/white) but textContent='' at seeks to 5s/12s/13.5s; timeline child tween present (start=11.92s, dur=1.2s, target v 8200->12600, progress 0.067 at t=12). pause(12, false) => textContent becomes '8767 件'.
defects.fix_direction: either capx seekTimeline pauses with suppressEvents=false (pause(t, false)), or timeline-builder.js counter writes text via tween progress in a non-event path (e.g. onUpdate rendered through gsap's render loop) — framework decision, belongs to capx+builder owners.
defects.found: counter renders no digits on ANY seeked frame (not a layout degradation)
defects.impact: counter effect unusable end-to-end in render path: L1 F360/A-C01-03 fails; any MP4 rendered through capx would show an empty counter for its whole window. F449 target 'counter settles at 12,600' also void.
defects.root_cause: platform/capx/renderer.go seekTimeline calls tl.pause(tSec) with one argument; GSAP Timeline.pause(atTime, suppressEvents) defaults suppressEvents=true, which skips callbacks (onUpdate/onStart) during the seek render. timeline-builder.js counter effect relies solely onUpdate to write digits.
